params.1273: Ask about the toll at the Al Kharid gate.
params.1274: The guards at the gate charge a toll for use of the gate. Talk to them to find out about the toll.
params.1275: Follow the road east away from Lumbridge Castle and cross the bridge.
params.1276: Keep following the road east until you reach the Al Kharid toll gate.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
